observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher uses a friendly, encouraging tone to guide students through basic dance steps. She breaks down movements into manageable parts and provides clear, repetitive verbal cues to help students follow along.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces the class and explains the goal of working on simple, big moves.
The teacher leads a short, simple warmup to get students moving.
The teacher breaks down step-touches, demonstrating the movement and explaining the arm placement.
The teacher introduces a 'drag' step, demonstrating the movement and explaining the footwork.
The teacher explains the importance of arm movement while bouncing, emphasizing the coordination between arms and legs.
The teacher breaks down a cross-step, emphasizing the footwork and the importance of watching the feet.
The teacher practices the cross-step slowly, encouraging students to follow along.
The teacher introduces a side-to-side movement, explaining the coordination and the importance of chest movement.
The teacher allows students to practice the moves to their own beat for a minute.

metaphors: Imagine you are squeezing something as you go down
common_mistakes: Feeling awkward while bouncing, which the teacher reassures is normal

steps_taught.name: Step-touch
steps_taught.description: A simple step to the side followed by a touch.

steps_taught.name: Drag
steps_taught.description: A step followed by a dragging motion of the other foot.

steps_taught.name: Cross-step
steps_taught.description: A step across the body followed by an unwind.

what_works: Breaking down complex movements into smaller parts
what_hinders: The teacher's costume might make it difficult to see some of the finer details of the footwork

quotes.text: So we're going to work on some simple, um, big moves first.
Okay, we're going to start with the step touches to the side.
So when you're bouncing, your arms up as you go down.
So really watch your feet here.
So my feet, watch them carefully, they kind of squeeze in and out.
So this time, I'm actually going to get you to just kind of move to your own beat.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the class, explaining the lesson plan.
The teacher demonstrates a step-touch, moving side to side.
The teacher demonstrates a drag step, showing the footwork.
The teacher explains the arm movement while bouncing.
The teacher demonstrates a cross-step, showing the footwork.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a full-body costume, which adds a unique visual element to the instruction.
